description: The States Corporate Digimap System is the public web mapping service of the States of Guernsey for Guernsey and Alderney. The map list read on 2026-09-28 includes free web maps of accessible parking and toilets, districts, schools and school catchments, antiquities, demographics from 2001 and 2014, a road works information map, historic fiefs, the planning service and Island Development Plan, protected sites, historic maps, AIS ship tracking, 1945 aerial photographs of Guernsey and Alderney, marine and coastal place names and a solar rooftops map, while the cadastral map is available by subscription only. Coverage is the Bailiwick islands of Guernsey and Alderney. Access is free for most maps and paid for cadastral data; no licence is stated for the free maps. Caveats: the maps are viewers without downloads, and themes such as utility networks are not public. It supports planning context, rooftop solar potential and road disruption studies on a small island system. Related records: data-guernsey-bailiwick-risk-register and the Guernsey residential property stock report complement it.
